title: Gear Shield
description: 🛡️ Smart durability alerts that warn you before your tools and armor break. Never lose your gear at the worst moment again.
body:
# 🛡️ GearShield

Never let your gear betray you at the worst moment.

GearShield alerts you before your tools and armor break, so you don’t lose your best items mid-fight, mining, or exploration.

## ⚡ Features

- 🔔 Real-time durability warnings

- 🛠️ Works for tools, weapons, and armor

- ⚠️ Warns when any gear's durablity is or less than 15%

- 🎮 Lightweight and performance-friendly

- 🔌 Built for Fabric

## 💡 Why You Need It

You’re mining diamonds… or fighting mobs… and suddenly your tool breaks.
GearShield makes sure that never happens again.

Stay prepared. Stay protected.
